print_errors.note: آل عمران ١٨: the print shows a plain fathatan on the mim with no small iqlab mīm (the Madinah mushaf / Tanzil has قَآئِمًۢا). Transcribed as printed.
التحريم ٨: no waqf sign (ۖ) printed after لَنَآ although the mushaf has one. Transcribed as printed.
المجادلة ٢٢: the print has no waqf sign after مِّنْهُ (the mushaf has ۖ). Transcribed as printed.

notes: p065 marker uses '+' : its first line (وَأَيِّدْنِي بِكَ لَكَ) starts flush at the margin and continues the dua paragraph of p064 (which ends with [آل عمران: ١٦٠].). p067 uses '+' because the Quran quotation ﴿رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ... is split by the page turn; since validate.py requires balanced ﴿﴾ on every line, the bracket is closed at the end of p066 (﴿رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى﴾) and reopened at the top of p067 (﴿ٱلدُّنْيَا ...﴾ [البقرة: ٢٠١]) — the print has one continuous quotation. p068 has no '+' (p067 ends with [التحريم: ٨]. and p068 starts a new block). Bold: on p065 the parenthesised phrases (وَأَيِّدْنِي بِكَ لَكَ)، (وَاجْمَعْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ)، (وَحُلْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ غَيْرِكَ) and (الله. الله. الله) are printed in a heavier face than the surrounding text, like the parenthesised phrases on p064, and are marked **…** including the parentheses; nothing else in the batch is bold. The word الله: the bold (الله. الله. الله) carries only the font's automatic marks → written الله; the six following occurrences carry a printed damma → written اللَّهُ per CONVENTIONS §2 example. On p066 the lam of the definite article is printed WITHOUT a sukun wherever the font uses the lam-mim / lam-kha / lam-ha ligature (المُرْسَلِينَ، المُتَّقِينَ، المُحَجَّلِينَ، المُذْنِبِينَ، الخَيْرِ، الهُدَىٰ، بِالمَعَارِفِ) while it is printed with a sukun elsewhere (الْغُرِّ، الْأَوَّلِ، الْأَغْيَارِ …); transcribed as printed (checked at 1000-1600 dpi). Dagger alif printed on ordinary (non-Quran) words (حَتَّىٰ، عَلَىٰ، إِلَىٰ، الهُدَىٰ) is kept as U+0670. وَأَوْجَبَ عَلَيْكَ الْبَيَانَ on p065 is set in the Uthmani font but outside ﴿﴾ → plain text; its alif has no wasla sign. Quran encoding follows the Tanzil table: silent alif/waw ۟ (U+06DF), small waw/yeh ۥ ۦ, waqf signs ۚ ۖ ۗ as printed, hamza-on-tatweel forms فَـَٔامَنَّا / سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا / يَـُٔودُهُۥ with the tatweel kept (it carries a mark). References keep the book's European digits on p068 ([الإخلاص: 1-4]، [الفلق: 1-5]) and the logical order of ranges (٢٧-٢٨، ١٩٣-١٩٤، ٢٦-٢٧، ٢٢-٢٤); a space is written after the colon in every reference although some are printed tight ([الفجر:٢٧-٢٨]، [الممتحنة:٤]، [الحشر:٢٢-٢٤]). Kashida stretching in [الـبقرة]، وَكَـفِّرْ، شَهِـدَ، ٱلْحَكِـيمُ، كُـلِّ etc. dropped. The basmala before الإخلاص and الفلق on p068 is printed in the small calligraphic form on the same line as the surah → written بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ outside the brackets, same paragraph.
